nodes.description: Public string state variable name = "Wrapped Ether".
Public string state variable symbol = "WETH".
Public uint8 state variable decimals = 18.
Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf tracking contract-held balances per account.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance tracking approvals.
receive() external payable fallback that forwards to deposit().
deposit() public payable credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with msg.value.
withdraw(uint wad) public debits balanceOf[msg.sender] then sends ether to msg.sender.
totalSupply() public view returns address(this).balance.
approve(address guy, uint wad) sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad.
transfer(address dst, uint wad) delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad).
transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad) moves balances with allowance check.
msg.sender external caller address used as mapping key and ether recipient.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= wad unchecked arithmetic subtraction in withdraw.
msg.sender.transfer(wad) external ether transfer performed after state update in withdraw.
uint wad parameter of withdraw controlling debited and transferred amount.
address guy parameter of approve, the spender being approved.
uint wad parameter of approve, the allowed amount.
address dst parameter of transfer, the recipient.
uint wad parameter of transfer, the amount moved.
address src parameter of transferFrom, the debited account.
address dst parameter of transferFrom, the credited account.
uint wad parameter of transferFrom, the amount moved.
balanceOf[src] -= wad and balanceOf[dst] += wad unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
allowance[src][msg.sender] -= wad unchecked arithmetic subtraction in transferFrom.

edges.reason: receive() unconditionally forwards execution to deposit().
deposit uses msg.sender as the key when crediting balanceOf.
deposit writes msg.value into the balanceOf state mapping.
withdraw authorization and debit amount are bound to the caller identity msg.sender.
withdraw executes the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= wad subtraction.
the unchecked subtraction mutates the balanceOf state variable.
withdraw performs an external ether transfer that can re-enter the contract.
the externally-influenced msg.sender is the target of the state-changing external transfer.
msg.sender selects which balance is debited by the unchecked subtraction.
the user-supplied wad parameter determines the value of the external transfer.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balanceOf debit and credit arithmetic.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented in transferFrom.
the unchecked debit and credit arithmetic mutates the balanceOf state mapping.
the unchecked allowance subtraction mutates the allowance state mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: the wad parameter only exists to feed withdraw's debit and transfer logic, so it collapses into the withdraw function node.
guy is only used as an index/event field inside approve and carries no independent semantic weight.
the approve wad parameter is fully absorbed into approve's allowance assignment.
dst is merely forwarded from transfer into transferFrom and has no standalone behavior.
the transfer wad parameter is passed straight through to transferFrom.
src selects the debited balance and approval entry within transferFrom only.
dst selects the credited balance within transferFrom only.
the transferFrom wad parameter governs the arithmetic performed inside transferFrom.
